cues.en: So here is the question.
cues.zh: 所以，問題是，

cues.en: Is it appropriate and valid to add noise when the noise is sampled from a completely different distribution as what the actual data show.
cues.zh: 當雜訊取樣自與實際資料完全不同的分布時，加入這種雜訊，適當且有效嗎？

cues.en: This is not you know, I'm not asking this as a rhetorical question where the answer is obviously no.
cues.zh: 我不是用反問的方式，暗示答案顯然是否定的。

cues.en: It's really unclear.
cues.zh: 這真的不清楚。

cues.en: You see many situations in science, in physics and biology where the noise has a different distribution from the signal.
cues.zh: 科學、物理、生物中，很多情況下，雜訊分布與訊號不同。

cues.en: And so what that means in a large language model, I think is still fairly open.
cues.zh: 因此，這在大型語言模型中代表什麼，我認為仍然相當開放。

cues.en: It's an unanswered question.
cues.zh: 是尚未解答的問題。

cues.en: I think that was a fun code challenge.
cues.zh: 我覺得，這是有趣的程式挑戰。

cues.en: I also have to say that I was really surprised to learn that the original Wizard of Oz movie was from 1939.
cues.zh: 也得說，知道原版《綠野仙蹤》電影是 1939 年的，真的很驚訝。

cues.en: For some reason, I thought it was like from the 70s until I made this lecture and looked it up.
cues.zh: 不知道為什麼，直到製作這堂課、查資料之前，我一直以為是七〇年代。

cues.en: Anyway, as I discussed earlier, randomly shuffling dimensions, especially if you are randomly shuffling every dimension is absolutely catastrophic.
cues.zh: 總之，前面討論過，隨機打亂維度，尤其是打亂每個維度，絕對是災難性的。

cues.en: Adding noise to existing activations, on the other hand, is basically just injecting some uncertainty
cues.zh: 另一方面，對既有活化加入雜訊，基本上只是向模型注入一些不確定性

cues.en: and stochasticity into the model that will make the model have a wider and flatter probability distribution when selecting the next token.
cues.zh: 與隨機性，讓模型在選擇下一個 token 時，機率分布更寬、更平。

cues.en: Now, it's not necessarily a bad thing, but it can be an interesting experimental manipulation.
cues.zh: 這不一定是壞事，但可以是一種有趣的實驗操作。

cues.en: To be honest, I'm not sure what is the conclusion about the distribution of noise versus signal.
cues.zh: 老實說，關於雜訊與訊號的分布，我不確定結論是什麼。

cues.en: As I mentioned at the end of the Python session, there are tons of examples in physics and biology
cues.zh: 如同 Python 示範結尾提過的，物理、生物、

cues.en: and finance and psychology and so on, where signals have different distributions than noise.
cues.zh: 金融、心理學等領域，都有大量訊號與雜訊分布不同的例子。

cues.en: And so the fact that they are differently distributed is certainly something to know about.
cues.zh: 所以，它們分布不同，當然是值得知道的事。

cues.en: But I wouldn't dismiss it out of hand as saying that it's inappropriate simply because the distribution shapes are different.
cues.zh: 但我不會單憑分布形狀不同，就直接否定、認為不適當。
